Method of Attack: Ransomware encrypts victim files and demands ransom for decryption
Distribution via affiliates using exploit kits (e.g., Fallout exploit kit)
Impacted Systems: Victim computers infected by GandCrab ransomware
Attack Vector: Affiliate distribution using Fallout exploit kit
Indicators of Compromise: BitDefender GandCrab decrypter available for versions 4 through 5.1
